info.name: Momna Core Foundation + Public API Runtime
info.description: Smoke, E2E and regression checks for the foundation plus deterministic CORE-API-01 public contract behavior.

exec: pm.test('ready schema', function () { var b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('READY'); pm.expect(b.checks).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('no sensitive readiness fields', function () { var t=pm.response.text().toLowerCase(); ['password','secret','connection','jdbc:','postgresql://'].forEach(function(x){pm.expect(t).not.to.include(x);}); });

item.name: Protected Core route rejects missing bearer with standard envelope

exec: pm.test('error envelope', function () { var b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.code).to.eql('AUTH_REQUIRED'); pm.expect(b.message).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.requestId).to.eql('postman-core-api-1'); });
pm.test('no internal leak', function () { var t=pm.response.text(); ['accessHash','refreshHash','providerSubject','sourceRef'].forEach(function(x){pm.expect(t).not.to.include(x);}); });
